response.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS average_wins FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins FROM race_averages GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins FROM country_averages), above_average AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.average_wins FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ca.average_wins > o.average_wins), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins FROM above_average) SELECT a.country, a.average_wins, a.average_wins - o.average_wins AS above_overall_average, a.average_wins - g.average_wins AS above_group_average FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE a.average_wins > g.average_wins ORDER BY a.average_wins DESC, a.country;
